note: Documents the tokens that exist today in frontend/app/globals.css. Values are measured, not aspirational.

type.note: Fonts are self-hosted through next/font, so the CSP needs no third-party font origin.

space: Tailwind default 4px scale (no arbitrary spacing values in components)

radius.note: rounded-lg and rounded-xl dominate; globals.css classes also use 11, 14 and 20 px, which are off-scale and are the cleanup candidates.

darkMode: Not shipped. The app is light-only by decision (an OS dark-mode leak once made input text white on white).
signature: A growth-curve motif and a clinical pine/paper palette: it reads as a record to be reviewed, not a chatbot.
